question: Which of the following is located in Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rani-ki-Vav.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani ki Vav**:

 
 
• It is a very famous **stepwell in Gujarat.** It is situated in the town of** Patan, Gujarat.**
 
• It is located on the bank of the** Saraswati river**. It was rediscovered and restored in the **1980s by the Archaeological Survey of India.**
 
• It is one of the** UNESCO's World Heritage Sites since 2014.**
 
• Its architecture is very defining as it was made in the form of an inverted temple.
 
• It is divided into seven levels of stairs, which have sculptural panels.
 
• It was constructed during the rule of the** Chalukyas dynasty.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Alai Darwaza**:

 
 
• The Alai Darwaza is the **main gate from the southern side of the Quwwat-****ul-Islam Mosque in the Qutub Minar complex.**
 
• **Allaudin Khilji** **constructed Alai Darwaza, the Palace of a thousand pillars, and the Fort of Siri.**
 
 
 
• **Humayun Tomb:**
 
 
• Humayun's tomb is located in **Delhi.** It was built in the **1560s, with the patronage of Humayun's son, the great Emperor Akbar.**
 
• it was the first** garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent.** It inspired several major **architectural innovations, culminating in the construction of the Taj Mahal.**
 
• Humayun's Tomb, Delhi is the earliest example of the **double dome in Mughal Architecture.**
 
• The** double or double-layered dome **has its outer layer which supports the white marble exterior, while the inner part gives shape to the cavernous interior volume.
 
• It was designed by the architect **Mirak Mirza Ghiyath.** It includes other contemporary, 16th-century Mughal garden-tombs such as **Nila Gumbad, Isa Khan, Bu Halima, Afsarwala, Barber's Tomb, and the complex where the craftsmen employed for the Building of Humayun's Tomb stayed, the Arab Serai.**
 
 
 
• Humayun's garden-tomb is also called** the dormitory of the Mughals as in the cells are buried over 150 Mughal family members.**

 
• **Bibi ka Maqbara:**

 
 
• **Bibi ka Maqbara' is a tomb situated in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India.**
 
• The Bibi-Ka-Maqbara is a** beautiful mausoleum of Rabia-ul-Daurani alias Dilras Banu Begum, the wife of the Mughal Emperor Aurangazeb (1658-1707 A.D.).**
 
• This mausoleum is believed to be constructed by** Prince Azam Shah in memory of his mother from 1651 to 1661 A.D**. An inscription found on the main entrance door mentions.
 
• **Source:** (Archeological Survey of India, Ministry of Culture).
